data.name: Install_DialogText
data.value:
This copy runs without being installed, so it can't update automatically. Install NativeNCA: it will appear in the Start menu, and you can install the update right after it starts.
Or download the new version manually from the release page.

data.name: Rollback_DialogText
data.value: NativeNCA will restart in version {0}. Your keys and settings are kept. Version {1} won't be offered automatically anymore; you can install it again with Check for updates.

data.name: Rename_Hint
data.value: Only you see the name: in the key list and in the signing confirmation window.

data.name: DeleteKey_DialogText
data.value: The encrypted copy of the key and the saved password will be removed from the NativeNCA vault. The original .p12 file stays on disk, so you can add the key again if needed.

data.name: SavePassword_DialogText
data.value: Enter the password for the key “{0}”. It will be checked and saved encrypted.

data.name: SavePassword_WrongMessage
data.value: Check the keyboard layout and try again

data.name: HelloVault_DialogTitle
data.value: Protect the vault with Windows Hello?

data.name: HelloVault_DialogText
data.value:
Keys and saved passwords will be additionally encrypted with a Windows Hello key that's stored in the TPM and never leaves this computer. Signing and changing the vault will require your face, fingerprint or PIN.
Important: if you reset your PIN or set up Windows Hello again, the vault can't be decrypted. Keep the original .p12 files and their passwords so you can add the keys again.

data.name: TlsRemove_DialogText
data.value:
The root certificate will be removed from Windows and the server certificate from disk. Windows will ask you to confirm.
Without it, browsers can connect to NativeNCA only if NCALayer is installed on this computer. You can install your own certificate again at any time.

data.name: TlsSetup_Intro
data.value: Websites connect to NativeNCA at the secure address wss://127.0.0.1:13579. So that browsers trust this connection, NativeNCA will create a certificate for this computer and add its root certificate to Windows.
